title: Consultant Services Story-Keyes Complete Street Improvement
short_description: Consultant services for environmental and historic documentation for a complete streets project.
project_scope: Preparation of an Area of Potential Effects (APE) Map, Archaeological Survey Report (ASR), and Historic Property Survey Report (HSPR) for the Story-Keyes Complete Streets Project in San Jose. The overall project is a street/highway complete streets improvement project with stated total construction cost of 45.1 million.
services: Consultant services for historic preservation and environmental documentation, including APE mapping, archaeological survey, and historic property survey; related disciplines listed include landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, land use planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, EIA/EIR/EIS, archaeology, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an environmental and historic documentation assignment, not structural or bridge design.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building component identified.
- Scope focuses on surveys, reports, planning, and studies, which are generally not a target area for sbp.
- Complete streets/streets-highways context does not indicate a technically demanding civil structure relevant to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost = $45.1M.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee or engineering fee stated in the source. The notice is for consultant reporting services only; no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants for historic preservation and related environmental documentation; specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
